senses.gloss:
Dāpaka (EI 3; BL; HD), usually regarded as the same as Dūtaka; but really ‘one who causes another to give’, i. e. the creator of a rent-free holding which was ratified by the king. Cf. Ep. Ind., Vol. XIX, pp. 177, 243.
 (CII 1), a matter relating to giving gifts.
dāpana, cf. dāpanāya (LP), ‘for making one pay’. See dāvāpana.
